sourceRefs.locator: AT-OeStA/HHStA UR AUR 9228. Dates and places, regest, extent and seal description: only the Nuremberg part of this copy bears a golden seal of 66.6–67.2 mm in diameter.
Introduction and chs. 1–4. Seven electors, meeting at Frankfurt, voting, confirmation of electors’ rights and precedence.
Panel Die Goldene Bulle. Chapters 1–23 at Nuremberg and 24–31 at Metz in 1356, name from the gold seal, surviving original copies.

labels.en: Issuing the electoral law at Nuremberg

note.de: Karl IV. erlässt die ersten 23 Kapitel der Goldenen Bulle. Sie bestimmen Frankfurt am Main als Wahlort. Der Punkt zeigt die Stadt der Ausfertigung.
note.en: Charles IV issues the first 23 chapters of the Golden Bull. They designate Frankfurt am Main for elections. The point marks the issuing town.
